title: The breathwork demo funnel wears the site header and footer, with no second wordmark or full-screen canvas

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const p=r('app/join/(induction)/page.tsx'),f=r('app/join/(induction)/feature-funnel.tsx');const bad=[];if((p.match(/<SiteShell>\{demo\}/g)||[]).length<3)bad.push('a feature-funnel path is not inside the site shell');if(!f.includes('{!fq && <span className=\"brandmark'))bad.push('the demo still draws its own wordmark under the Frequency design');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1279: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Owner 2026-10-22 funnel pass, step two (after LIVE-1277). Under the Frequency design the feature funnel (the free breathwork timer door) renders inside the site shell on all three paths (signed out, staff preview, signed in), and drops its own <main>, brandmark and amber canvas.
